name: Feed Tamper Read Time
description: A Tamper plugin for Feeds/Tamper pipelines that estimates reading time (whole minutes) from an HTML value using a configurable words-per-minute rate.
project_description: Provides a single Tamper plugin ("Read Time Calculator") that computes an estimated reading time from an HTML value: it extracts the text (via DOMDocument/XPath, dropping script and style), counts words, divides by a configurable words-per-minute rate, rounds up, and returns the whole-minute count as a string. It plugs into any Feeds/Tamper import pipeline so a read-time field can be populated automatically from imported content.
